The '''Galactic Empire Exploratory Division''' was the [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] unit in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was in operation a short time before the outbreak of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
